beats.headline: One does not pierce cats
beats.text: It's not going to happen, Donut says: does she look like some sort of sex pervert? It gives plus ten and an additional five percent to her constitution, Carl says, and it is the smallest of the four; it will hide in her fur and probably shrink once attached. She will have to attach it manually the first time, and one does not pierce the nipples of cats; that is how one gets a visit from the ASPCA. Why doesn't he wear it himself? He is, Carl says, a bigger one. Of the four rings off Iota, two are for selling, the third gives Quarter Fall, and the fourth is this constitution ring, about the size of a nickel.

beats.headline: Bought with a sponsor prize
beats.text: A sponsor's note has just told Carl to give his new Pawna's Cries potion to Donut and keep it secret. If she puts the nipple ring on, he says, she gets his sponsor prize. She licks her lips. Mordecai looks about to speak, and Carl gives him a slight no. Donut agrees, if he goes first and they don't tell Katia. He shoves the needle through his left nipple. I don't think I can respect you anymore, Donut says, and an achievement arrives, Sex Pervert, whose reward is that whores don't get rewards. He searches her belly for a nipple. Not that one: up higher, on the other side. The top right. Okay, Carl says, he is going to count to three.

beats.headline: Was the bribe a trick
beats.text: Don't let that nipple ring fool you, Donut tells Bautista: Carl doesn't get very many girls. Then Elle and Imani report benefactor boxes from the Apothecary, also for Donut, and Donut starts to think the nipple ring bribe was a trick, and that Carl was directed to give her that potion all along.

beats.headline: One, two, stab
beats.text: Donut is still on about it, days after. Once trust is broken it can never be replaced, she tells Carl: if someone says they are going to count to three, one expects them to actually count to three, not to stab willy-nilly into one's body without warning. She didn't get to prepare herself.
